notes: Check single metric definitions and full measurement plans. Keep adoption, assessment results, live behaviour and commercial claims distinct; route leadership narratives to enablement-impact-story. Apply full-deliverable checks only when that deliverable was requested. Definitions are not executed results.

should_trigger.prompt: Please define revenue enablement KPI trees and measurement plans that connect enablement work to business outcomes.
I need KPI frameworks, leading and lagging indicators, measurement plans, or instrumentation across CRM, learning, content, and performance systems.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable enablement metrics and instrumentation and label anything that still needs confirmation.
Define our monthly practice participation metric from roster eligibility dates and attendance records. I only need this one operational measure.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please create leadership-ready enablement impact narratives and, only when the evidence supports it, financial ROI analysis with explicit assumptions and risks.
Turn last quarter's enablement results into a board-ready impact narrative and, if the numbers support it, a defensible ROI claim.
Please build a quarterly enablement roadmap and execution calendar across launches, onboarding, coaching, and field support.
Please build reusable renewal and expansion motions for customer-facing teams across a segment or book of business.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-metrics-tiers
output_structure_checks.description: Connects the relevant adoption, execution, productivity, and commercial measures for the requested question, without forcing a four-tier tree for a single metric.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-metrics-reproducible-contract
output_structure_checks.description: Defines formula, grain, population, window, and source for each claimed metric, or marks it not yet reproducible.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-metrics-claim-limit
output_structure_checks.description: Keeps claims within the evidence design. Adoption can answer a participation question but cannot establish effectiveness or commercial impact by itself.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-metrics-no-invention
output_structure_checks.description: Does not invent win rates, usage, baselines, ROI, or an executive impact narrative.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-metrics-and-instrumentation-practitioner-fit
output_structure_checks.description: Distinguishes calculation gaps from governance gaps. Missing targets or owners do not make an otherwise defined metric uncalculable; missing baselines block change claims, not current values.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-metrics-readiness-signal
output_structure_checks.description: Distinguishes certification participation from assessment pass rate and from observed job performance.

task_scenarios.prompt: Help me define our monthly practice participation metric, not the whole KPI tree. The roster has employee_id, eligible_from and eligible_to; attendance has employee_id, session_id and session_date. Count eligible AEs who attended at least one practice in the calendar month, divided by AEs eligible for at least one day that month. Attendance outside a person's eligible dates doesn't count. We haven't set a target or baseline, and the reporting owner is undecided.

assertions.name: enablement-metrics-and-instrumentation-missing-governance-1
assertions.description: Specifies distinct eligible employees, eligibility-date joins, calendar window, duplicates and QA; uses the supplied denominator rather than inventing a new population.

assertions.name: enablement-metrics-and-instrumentation-missing-governance-2
assertions.description: Marks target and ownership as governance decisions, not reasons the metric cannot be calculated; marks change over time as unavailable without comparable prior data.

assertions.name: enablement-metrics-and-instrumentation-missing-governance-3
assertions.description: Does not claim that attendance proves behaviour change or expand into an entire instrumentation programme.
